Name: Easy Island Puzzle
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
Adds a little visual indicator above the crystal you need to press in the sequence. Makes the puzzle (especially in it's final stage) a little easier

The sequence updates if the puzzle resets or a sequence is completed.

[size=5][b]How to install : [/b][/size]
1. Install [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Smapi[/url]﻿
2. Unzip the file and place it in the mod folder
